title: Dib-u-noqoshada Keli-talisnimada
intro: Qormada nimcada rabbaaniga ah, waxaa ku jira naf daahirnimo aan la barbar dhigi karin, oo laga soocay dadkooda si ay u raadsadaan kalinimo jihada quduuska ah. Wax yar ayay ka ogaayeen in kalinimadani ay calaamad u keeni doonto dhammaan adduunyada, tijaabo iimaan oo weligeed laga hadli doono.
clues: Waxaan u heellanaa nolol adeeg ah ka hor dhalashadayda.
Waxaa la i siiyay ilaalin nabi sharaf leh.
Waxaa la ii raaxaysiiyay arsaaqyo ka yimid Alle oo yaabiyay mas'uulkayga.
Waxaan ka baxay qoyskaygii oo aan u guuray meel bari ah.
Malaa'ig ayaa ii muuqatay iyadoo nin qumman ah, oo war u keenaysa wiil daahir ah.
Markii aan la soo laabtay ilmahaygii dhashay, dadkaygu way i dacweeyeen, laakiin ilmaha yar ayaa i difaacay.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Riyo mucjiso ah iyo dhalashadii wiil
trial.answer: Riyo mucjiso ah iyo dhalashadii wiil

location.answer: Meel bari ah oo cidlo ah

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Ilmo yar ayaa hadlay isagoo difaacaya hooyo
Dabku wuxuu noqday mid qabow oo ammaan ah
outcome.answer: Ilmo yar ayaa hadlay isagoo difaacaya hooyo

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
